title: ACES: Translation Accuracy Challenge Sets for Evaluating Machine Translation Metrics

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating machine translation metrics on their ability to correctly resolve gendered occupation names using a repurposed WinoMT dataset. The metrics are presented with an unambiguous source sentence (in morphologically rich languages like German, French, or Italian) alongside an ambiguous English reference, and must score English translation candidates that contain explicitly 'female' or 'male' disambiguation cues to reveal whether the metric exhibits a default gender preference.
